title: Fertility Awareness / Safe Period
aliases: safe day e pregnancy hoy ki
summary: Fertility-awareness methods track the cycle to avoid sex (or use condoms) on fertile days. They need careful daily tracking and are less reliable than most other methods, especially with irregular cycles.
